title: Combined Trellis K4/K6/K8 (Embedding + lm_head) KLD
method: End-to-end KLD when BOTH embed_tokens and lm_head are trellis-quantized to the same K level. Step 1: pre-encode both [248320, 5120] tensors. Step 2: inject quantized embedding into vLLM, capture hidden states (error propagates through 48 layers). Step 3: project captured hidden states through quantized lm_head, compute full-vocab KL vs BF16 reference hidden states through BF16 lm_head. Same 512-context v5 shard-0000 suite (1,048,064 scored positions).

comparison.notes: BF16 baseline is the trellis K5K6 model with BF16 embed+head (the control). 'embed only' and 'lm_head only' KLDs are measured differently (end-to-end vs isolated) and are not additive. 'combined' is the true end-to-end measurement with both quantized.

key_findings: Combined K8 KLD (0.002286) is LOWER than the BF16 baseline (0.002700) and lower than embed-K8-only (0.002653). The lm_head K8 quantization error is so tiny (3e-05) that it's lost in the noise of the embedding quantization, and the Hadamard rotation in the head may slightly decorrelate errors.
Combined K6 KLD (0.002585) is also below the BF16 baseline (0.002700) and below embed-K6-only (0.002667). Same effect — lm_head K6 error (3e-04) is small compared to embedding error.

Combined K4 KLD (0.006763) is 2.5x the BF16 baseline (0.002700) but still under the 0.012 budget. This is where both components contribute meaningfully: embed K4 (0.002857) + lm_head K4 (0.004304), but the combined is less than the sum (0.007161) — the errors partially cancel.

K8 and K6 combined are below baseline because the trellis K5K6 model's BF16 embed+head control (0.002700) already carries the trellis quantization error of the K5/K6 MLP/attention layers, and the additional K8/K6 error on embed+head is smaller than the measurement noise.
p99 KLD: K8=0.02611, K6=0.02690, K4=0.04171. K4 is the only one exceeding the 0.0349 BF16 baseline p99.
top1 agreement: K8=98.05%, K6=97.71%, K4=95.53%. All maintain >95% greedy decoding agreement.
All three combined configs are under the 0.012 KLD budget. K4 is the tightest at 0.006763 (1.8x margin).
